purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Nyaribari Masaba Form 34B final TOTAL row and preserve an internal source arithmetic defect without promotion.

sample.review_context_note: Rendered at 400 DPI (3-page official IEBC Form 34B PDF; the TOTAL row is on page 3 of 3, the final row of the polling-station table). Re-read at 200 DPI and again at 400 DPI with identical digits both times; every cell is unambiguous.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image at 200 DPI and again at 400 DPI, with identical results. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-266-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), sourced from the pre-election official IEBC First Schedule registered-voters gazette, published 2022-06-21

note: Registered voters (68,593) matches the governed P23 denominator exactly. However, the four candidate cells on the TOTAL row sum to 42,643 (26,096 + 16,240 + 112 + 195) while the row's own printed Total Valid Votes is 42,664 (delta 21). Re-read at 200 DPI and again at 400 DPI with identical digits both times to rule out a misread; every figure on the source image is unambiguous. This is a genuine printed-form defect on the constituency TOTAL row itself, matching the Fafi, Kipkelion West and Bomet Central precedents from earlier tranches. Per form34b-extraction-contract.json (prohibited_methods bars silently correcting digits to force reconciliation), this row is recorded as verification_state=arithmetic_mismatch and not promoted.
